review_policy: Explicit per input/output judgments, no blanket rejection of negative Topic. Generic costs one when a useful target is clear. Short on-topic invitations are acceptable for ordinary observations. Strict contradictions and wrong topics have cost ratios above; mild pragmatic/temporal mismatch separately graded. No single-error veto. Frequency/cost scenarios are assumptions, not empirical estimates. Original unapproved head and all live thresholds remain unchanged.
